gloss: to harbor; to carry (a child); to reflect (light)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {宿|やど}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to harbor, to hold within, to carry
definitions.explanation: To contain or hold something intangible within oneself — an emotion, a thought, a spirit, or a quality.
To become pregnant, to carry a child in one's womb. A literary or formal expression.
For a surface to hold or reflect light, moisture, or color. A poetic expression.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive (〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{宿|やど}す)
- Pair: ⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧ (intransitive: to dwell in, to be present within; ⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧)

USAGE:
{宿|やど}す has a literary, elevated tone across all senses. The intransitive form ⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧ (to dwell in, to be present within) is also common and appears in similar contexts. The transitive {宿|やど}す emphasizes the subject actively harboring or imbuing something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{宿|やど}す: to carry a life
- ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{宿|やど}す: to conceive a child
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{宿|やど}す: to imbue with power
- ⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧: a soul dwells (intransitive form)
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{宿|やど}す: to hold tears
